method: STRIDE pass by the execute agent over tenant isolation, sandbox minting and privacy (an independent reviewer is scheduled by the orchestrator)

scenarios.scenario: Spoof another sandbox by editing the cookie w/a claims
scenarios.rationale: HMAC-verified cookie (verifyCookie, constant-time); forged or mixed w/a -> 401 (sandbox-isolation); analyst must belong to the workspace (liveness JOIN)

scenarios.scenario: Bind a cookie to ws_demo to write into the demo
scenarios.rationale: liveness requires kind='sandbox' (401 even for a correctly signed ws_demo cookie); demo write-block triggers outside seed_mode (demo-workspace-not-polluted)

scenarios.scenario: Edit or delete a past decision or audit row
scenarios.rationale: decision_guard_update lists every immutable column; append-only triggers on decision/audit/answer; only the 'purging' state allows DELETE (triggers, decision-append-only, audit-trail-append-only)

scenarios.scenario: Forge memory by sending a fingerprint that does not match the quote
scenarios.rationale: server recomputes the fingerprint from quote_text with the run's firm -> 422 (decision-record-contract)

scenarios.scenario: Repudiate a decision or revoke
scenarios.rationale: exactly one audit row per write op, inserted first in the same atomic batch, with actor name, time and reason (audit-trail-append-only)

scenarios.scenario: Read another workspace's or firm's memory through any route or the RulesPort
scenarios.rationale: every statement binds workspace_id from the cookie (statement lint + inline-SQL lint); composite FKs; RulesPort is workspace-bound (memory-no-cross-firm-or-workspace, rules-port-scoped)

scenarios.scenario: Leak sensitive numbers or finding facts into server storage
scenarios.rationale: detail never persisted (R1); maskFree on every free-text field; masked before truncation; full quote dropped after hashing (memory-storage-contract with canaries and 9-digit runs)

scenarios.scenario: Client-chosen ids (finding_ref, client_op_id, pattern_key) carry raw account numbers into storage
scenarios.rationale: ids are stored unmasked (finding_ref <= 64 chars, client_op_id <= 64, pattern_key restricted to [a-z0-9:#>-]). LOW: they are client-generated identifiers, never displayed as text; Phase 08 client must generate them from engine ids only. Recorded as a non-blocking residual.

scenarios.scenario: Mint sandboxes in a loop to burn the D1 write budget
scenarios.rationale: session_new caps (5 per IP hash/day, 300 global/day ~ 25% of rows/day budget, from S9), Turnstile when configured, read-only degrade over the global cap (session-cookie-workerd)

scenarios.scenario: Flood memory read routes (no in-isolate pre-limit on memory routes)
scenarios.rationale: LOW residual: memory routes require a valid sandbox cookie and are bounded per request (<= 200 fingerprints, <= 50 findings, body caps); there is no per-minute limiter on memory reads (D1 Free 5M rows read/day). Candidate follow-up: reuse the 04a pre-limiter for memory routes (Phase 08/10).

scenarios.scenario: Exceed the per-invocation budget
scenarios.rationale: worst endpoint 10 queries, session with purge slot 29, AI worst path 9 queries + 2 fetches (query-budget); remote S8 showed fetches, not D1 queries, hit the 50 limit

scenarios.scenario: Make AI reachable before Phase 05 via the new D1 wiring
scenarios.rationale: with D1 wired and no TURNSTILE_SECRET, /api/ai and /api/ocr refuse before any claim or upstream call whether or not OPENROUTER_API_KEY is set (ai-fail-closed-without-secrets)

scenarios.scenario: Purge deletes the demo or a live sandbox
scenarios.rationale: purge marks only kind='sandbox' AND expires_at <= now; CHECK keeps demo 'active'; demo delete trigger; single atomic batch (memory-retention-purge-test)

scenarios.scenario: Write flood within ONE valid sandbox (review M1): loop POST /api/runs/:id/findings, /api/decisions or /api/runs to exhaust the D1 Free 100k rows-written/day budget
scenarios.rationale: Fix cycle 1: memoryCtx(write:true) claims a per-workspace daily counter (quota_counter guarded UPSERT, scope 'rate', key mw|req|<ws>|<day>, 1 row per request) capped at 600 mutating requests/day; POST /api/runs also claims mw|run (5/day) and findings claim mw|fnd by chunk size (2,000/day). Refusal = 429 rate_limited (workspace_write_limit / workspace_run_limit / workspace_findings_limit) with retry-after and ZERO rows written. Worst case per sandbox ~600 requests x <=25 rows bounded by the run/finding caps (~2-5k rows/day), and sandbox minting stays capped at 5/IP and 300/day. Proven by memory-write-limits (cap refusal writes 0 rows, flood loop stops at the cap, per-workspace scope, UTC-day reset); query-budget and rows-written gates still pass

scenarios.scenario: Loop POST /api/session after the global sandbox cap with a fresh Turnstile pass (review L1)
scenarios.rationale: The degrade branch no longer refunds the per-IP claim: after 5 calls/IP/day the IP gets 429 session_limit with zero rows written

scenarios.scenario: Global cap orphaning a user's own live sandbox by replacing it with the ro cookie (review L6)
scenarios.rationale: At the global cap a live sandbox cookie (verified w/a, kind sandbox, active, unexpired) is returned as-is; only absent/expired sandboxes degrade to read-only

scenarios.scenario: CPU exhaustion via a 50-finding / 157 KB findings body parsed before auth (review L5, S10)
scenarios.rationale: Cookie signature is verified (no DB) before the body is read or parsed on every memory POST; findings chunks above 25 are refused 413 findings_chunk before schema parse

scenarios.scenario: Store arbitrary characters in client-chosen ids (client_op_id, finding_ref, finding id) or unmasked account numbers in blockId/detector_id/model (review L2)
scenarios.rationale: parseWith enforces ID_RE on client_op_id and finding_ref; finding ids checked against ID_RE; blockId, detector_id and model pass through maskFree before persisting

scenarios.scenario: Concurrent double-approve of one rule writes two rule_approved audit events (review L4)
scenarios.rationale: Rule approve/reject/revoke insert the audit row only WHERE the rule is still in the expected prior status; UPDATE meta.changes = 0 -> replay result or 409 with the frozen ConflictBody (current: null), as decisions.ts (fix cycle 2, N2); covered end to end by the N4 race test

scenarios.scenario: UPDATE/DELETE of ws_demo rows on tables without demo triggers (review L3)
scenarios.rationale: Migration 0005 adds demo_ro_*_update (review_run, counsel_answer, fund, document, analyst) and demo_ro_*_delete (firm_rule, rule_evidence, analyst, fund, document, review_run, finding, finding_state, counsel_question); 0002 untouched

scenarios.scenario: Mint-and-flood: an attacker mints sandboxes from several IPs (5/IP/day, global 300) and floods writes in each, so the per-workspace caps alone let ~2 IPs exhaust the 100k rows/day D1 Free write budget (re-review N1/M1)
scenarios.rationale: resolveSession takes a global weighted daily write-row budget claim (rate scope, key mw|rows|<day>, cap 40,000 units, guarded quota_counter UPSERT) after the per-workspace claim on every memory write. Weights cover measured rows (decision 25, run 12, counsel answer 18, findings chunk n+5, other 10; asserted in rows-written). Refusal is 429 rate_limited memory_write_budget with retry-after to the next UTC day and writes no row beyond the prior per-workspace claim. Sessions, AI and OCR are not charged, so they keep working. Worst case/day ~= 40k memory + ~36k sessions (300 x ~120) + AI/OCR claim rows < 100k.

scenarios.scenario: Reload loop burns the per-IP sandbox claim and mints a new sandbox per reload (re-review N6)
scenarios.rationale: POST /api/session reuses a live sandbox cookie BEFORE the per-IP claim at any cap level (0 rows written); liveSandbox() only accepts kind='sandbox' active unexpired rows, so a read-only demo cookie is never reissued as a demo-bound workspace cookie
